audit_meta.scope: Ironclad bounded-type wiring wave (6 commits, 37 .rs files)
audit_meta.contract_status: MISMATCH — .contract.sha256 stale (cd8ad37...) vs actual shared/mod.rs (be9d346...). Expected: shared/mod.rs changed to add bounded_types/lifecycle_types/entity_types submodules.

findings.issue: Gold overflow on add. saturating_add caps at u32::MAX (4.2B) not Gold::MAX (9,999,999). new_unchecked bypasses validation, so gold can silently exceed 9,999,999.
findings.notes: Confirmed by reading gold.rs:24. saturating_add(gain) where gain is unbounded u32.

findings.issue: Gold overflow on sell revenue. Same pattern as AUD-001: saturating_add can exceed 9,999,999.
findings.notes: Confirmed at shop.rs:272. total_revenue from saturating_mul is uncapped.

findings.issue: Gold overflow on UI sell path. player.gold.get() + price uses bare addition (not even saturating) — can panic on overflow AND exceed Gold::MAX.
findings.notes: Confirmed at shop_screen.rs:679. Bare + operator, not saturating_add. Worst of the three gold-add sites.

findings.issue: MineFloor wraps current_floor + 1 with new_unchecked. Game logic caps at floor 20 (line 56), so 21 is within MineFloor bounds (0..=120). Safe in practice but fragile — if cap changes to 120 later, floor 121 would violate bounds.
findings.notes: Game caps at 20, MineFloor allows 120. Safe now but coupling between game constant and type bound is implicit.

findings.issue: Health::new_unchecked(player_state.max_health * 0.5) where max_health is bare f32 (currently const 100.0). Safe with current constants but breaks if max_health ever exceeds 200.
findings.notes: max_health is f32 in PlayerState (mod.rs:291), not a bounded type. Same pattern at combat.rs:304, interaction.rs:626/636.

findings.issue: Stamina::new_unchecked(player_state.max_stamina) where max_stamina is bare f32. Safe with current const MAX_STAMINA=100.0 but unguarded.
findings.notes: Same pattern at interaction.rs:626. max_stamina is f32 (mod.rs:289).

findings.issue: Contract checksum stale. .contract.sha256 contains cd8ad37... but shared/mod.rs now hashes to be9d346... due to bounded_types/lifecycle_types/entity_types submodule additions.
findings.suggestion: sha256sum src/shared/mod.rs | awk '{print $1 "  src/shared/mod.rs"}' > .contract.sha256 && git add .contract.sha256
findings.notes: Expected divergence from the ironclad retrofit. Needs formal amendment per contract amendment process.

findings.issue: Uses *player_state.stamina < 20.0 (Deref) instead of .get(). Functionally identical but inconsistent with .get() pattern used everywhere else.
findings.notes: Style only. Deref works but .get() is the project convention.

false_positives_rejected.reason: saturating_sub result is always ≤ current gold which is already in bounds. Additionally guarded by if player_state.gold.get() >= cost.
0 is unconditionally within Gold bounds (0..=9999999). new_unchecked(0) is correct for the clamp-to-zero fallback.
saturating_sub result is always ≤ current gold. Safe.
Pre-checked at line 630: if player.gold.get() >= listing.price. Subtraction is guarded.
Code does (*player_state.health - damage).max(0.0). The .max(0.0) clamps floor. Result is 0..=current_health which is ≤ 100. Safe.
Code does (stamina.get() - ev.amount).max(0.0). Clamped to 0 minimum, result ≤ current stamina ≤ 100. Safe.

false_positives_rejected.claim: ladder.rs:202 — new_unchecked with user-selected elevator floor
false_positives_rejected.reason: Floor comes from mine_state.elevator_floors (populated only at multiples of 5 up to current max floor) or hardcoded 1. All values are within MineFloor bounds.

summary.pattern: All 3 errors are the same root cause: Gold addition (saturating_add or bare +) can exceed Gold::MAX (9,999,999) because saturating_add caps at u32::MAX. Fix: add .min(9999999) before new_unchecked on every Gold addition site.
summary.next_action: Fix AUD-001 through AUD-003 (gold overflow). AUD-004 through AUD-006 are future-proofing — fix when max_health/max_stamina become bounded types. AUD-007 requires contract amendment.
